description: The nth Leonardo number. L(0) and L(1) are 1, and L(n) = L(n-1) + L(n-2) + 1. L(4) is 9, and L(10) is 177. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 4096. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/leonardo
